data.body_html:
Imagine gliding along the Costa del Sol as the sun dips behind La Concha, painting the sky in shades of orange and pink. An Estepona boat charter sunset cruise with romantic dinner 2026 offers exactly that—a private, unforgettable evening on the water. Our fleet departs from Puerto Banús, just 15 minutes from Estepona, and includes everything you need: skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and insurance. Whether you want a quiet escape for two or a celebration with friends, we have the perfect boat.

Why Choose an Estepona Sunset Cruise?

Estepona’s coastline is quieter than Marbella’s, with hidden coves like Cala del Faro and Cala Cortés that are perfect for anchoring at sunset. A boat charter gives you exclusive access to these spots, away from crowded beaches. The evening sea is typically calm, and the temperatures are pleasant even in July (around 26°C). With a skipper handling navigation, you can focus on each other and the scenery.

Our Fleet for Sunset and Dinner Cruises

We offer 15+ boats, all departing from Puerto Banús. For a romantic dinner, smaller boats like the Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) or Mariah SX21 (6.4m, 5 pax) provide an intimate setting. Larger groups can choose the Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) or the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax), which includes a free jet ski for 4-hour minimum bookings. All boats are equipped with comfortable seating, a sound system, and a shaded area.

What’s Included in Your Sunset Cruise

Every booking includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). For a romantic dinner, you can order a catering package with fresh seafood, paella, or a private chef. We also offer decorations, champagne, and photography services. Contact us via WhatsApp to arrange these extras.

Best Sunset Spots Near Estepona

Our skippers know the best anchorages. Popular sunset spots include Cala del Faro, a small cove with views of the lighthouse, and Cala Cortés, a quiet bay surrounded by cliffs. You can also cruise towards Puerto Banús to see the luxury yachts lit up at dusk. The Golden Mile offers a stunning backdrop with La Concha mountain turning gold in the evening light.

How to Book Your Estepona Sunset Cruise 2026

Booking is simple. Visit our [Marbella boat charter](/blog/estepona-boat-charter-sunset-cruise-romantic-dinner-2026/) page to see availability, or message us on WhatsApp. We recommend booking at least one week in advance, especially for summer weekends. A deposit secures your slot, and the balance is due 48 hours before departure. We’ll confirm the exact sunset time and meeting point at Puerto Banús.

Tips for a Perfect Romantic Evening

Dress in layers—evening sea breezes can be cool. Bring a camera for the sunset photos. If you’re planning a proposal, let us know in advance so we can arrange champagne and a quiet spot. The standard drinks package includes cava, but you can bring your own favourite wine. Our skipper will anchor in a calm spot away from other boats, so you have privacy.

Compare with Other Options

While Estepona has waterfront restaurants, nothing compares to a private boat. A dinner at a beach club costs around €100–€150 per person, but a sunset cruise gives you exclusivity, a personal skipper, and the freedom to choose your anchorage. For a similar experience in Marbella, see our [Marbella sunset cruise](/sunset-cruise-marbella/). For a day trip, check out [Puerto Banús boat hire](/boat-rental-puerto-banus/).
